# atlantis

Portable coding-agent operating mode and persistent Brain maintenance.

## Key documents

- README.md: installation, commands, Agent Skill, and safety boundaries
- docs/architecture.md: ownership and dependency direction
- docs/integrations.md: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, OMP, OpenCode, Skill, and verification-skill installation

## Core

- internal/brain: vault indexing, validation, and plan cleanup
- internal/cli: Brain maintenance and version commands
- integrations: native Brain context loading for supported harnesses
- .agents/skills/atlantis: operating mode and playbooks
- .agents/skills/create-verification-skill: generate project-local verify-<app> skills
- .agents/skills/maintain-verification-skill: audit and refresh verify-<app> feature maps
- .agents/skills/verify-atlantis: dogfood verification map for the Atlantis CLI
